desc.zh: 从覆盖字母到反向擦除，用阻塞计数构造戳印顺序。
desc.en: Turn overwrites into reverse erasures, then unlock windows with blocker counts.

complexity: O(nm) time; O(nm) auxiliary space and O(n) output, where m=len(stamp), n=len(target)

concepts.name: Reverse stamping legality
concepts.description: Only visible matches may be erased; each useful erase removes a new letter.

concepts.name: Blocker dependency queue
concepts.description: Erasing a position decrements exactly the windows originally blocked by it.

concepts.name: Monotone erasure invariant
concepts.description: Removing constraints cannot disable a legal window; reverse the productive erasures.
